program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((seeds (find-color g 2)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
          (if (not (= v 0))
              v
              (if (any?
                    (lambda (p)
                      (let ((sr (fst p))
                            (sc (snd p)))
                        (cond
                          [(= sr r)
                           (all?
                             (lambda (cc) (not (= (cell-at g r cc) 1)))
                             (range (+ (min sc c) 1) (max sc c)))]
                          [(= sc c)
                           (all?
                             (lambda (rr) (not (= (cell-at g rr c) 1)))
                             (range (+ (min sr r) 1) (max sr r)))]
                          [else #f])))
                    seeds)
                  4
                  0)))))))
